updates.title: The slate landed
updates.body: Eleven tonnes from Ffestiniog, stacked in the yard for a fortnight while the roofers finish the west pitch. It is a colder grey than the sample, which we prefer and did not plan.

updates.title: Seven rooms plastered
updates.body: Lime, three coats, and each one needs a week between them, which is why this took the whole summer and why the last four are next spring's problem.

updates.title: The kitchen is commissioned
updates.body: Signed with a workshop in Machynlleth. Oak, and one long run rather than an island, because the room is eleven feet wide and an island would be a wall.

updates.title: We had the survey back on the dune
updates.body: The marram is holding and the channel has moved nine metres east since the 2019 chart. Neither is a problem for the building. Both change the walk to the water.

faq.a: No. Nothing is bookable and there is no deposit to pay. The list is a list; when the first wave opens in February, everyone on it gets forty-eight hours before the public.
Nothing, and it never will. We are not selling a membership and there is no tier above the one you are on.
Roughly monthly, and only when something has actually happened. Four emails have gone out in the last twelve months.

Partly, and honestly: Ferryman is step-free from the yard door and has a level shower. The other ten rooms are up at least one flight, and the second floor has a low door. The lift we would need does not fit the stair core.
Above the Dyfi estuary in Gwynedd, four miles of tidal sand from the door. The nearest station is Penhelyg; we will publish the walk when there is something to walk to.
It sits in one list, used to send the five emails described on this site, and nothing else. No advertising, no sharing, no analytics profile. Unsubscribing removes the row.

emails.subject: Confirm your address
emails.preheader: One tap, and then nothing until there is news.
emails.heading: One tap and you're on the list

blocks.text: Somebody put this address on the list for Marram. If that was you, confirm it below and we will stop bothering you until there is something true to say.
If it wasn't you, ignore this. Nothing happens, and the address is deleted in seven days.

emails.signoff: No deposit, no booking, no card. It is a list.

emails.subject: You're on the list
emails.preheader: Number 1,204, and what that actually gets you.
emails.heading: You're on the list

blocks.text: The first season goes out as 40 invitations in two waves — February and April. Everyone here gets forty-eight hours before the public each time.
Being high on the list is not a reservation and does not hold a room. It decides the order the invitations go out in, and nothing else.

emails.signoff: Roughly monthly, and only when something has happened.

emails.subject: Two rooms, if you know the estuary
emails.preheader: The only thing we will ever ask you for.
emails.heading: The only ask, and it is a small one

blocks.alt: Dry marram grass on the dune above the house, bending in the wind.

blocks.text: We are not advertising this and we are not going to. The list has grown by people telling one other person, which is the rate we can actually build for.

If somebody comes to mind — the one who knows this coast, or has been looking for somewhere to put a long weekend — send them the link. That is the whole scheme. There is no discount and no leaderboard.

emails.signoff: You can leave the list at the bottom of any of these.

emails.subject: 7 of 11, and the slate is here
emails.preheader: Photographs, and what is still wrong with the kitchen.
emails.heading: 7 of 11 rooms plastered

blocks.alt: An unfinished room at Marram: bare lime plaster, a deep window onto the estuary, a step-ladder against the far wall.

blocks.text: Eleven tonnes from Ffestiniog, stacked in the yard for a fortnight while the roofers finish the west pitch. It is a colder grey than the sample, which we prefer and did not plan. It landed on 12 Aug 2026.

Lime takes three coats and a week between each, which is why seven rooms took the whole summer and the last four are next spring's problem. The kitchen is commissioned and the run is eleven feet, which is shorter than we wanted.
Nothing here is bookable yet. This is a progress note, not an offer.

emails.signoff: Four of these have gone out in twelve months.

emails.subject: Your window opens on Thursday
emails.heading: Your window is open

blocks.text: Wave one opens on Thursday at nine. You have forty-eight hours before the public list, and there are 40 invitations going out across the rooms that are finished.
The tag with a number on it is already on its hook. If Thursday does not suit, wave two is in April and you keep your place.

emails.signoff: Thank you for waiting two and a half years.
